question: The ten percent law of energy transfer was given by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raymond Lindeman**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The energy in an ecosystem flows from the Producer → Herbivore/Primary Consumer → Carnivore/Secondary consumer
 
• At each successive trophic level, there is only a 10% transfer of energy<
